name: clean-info-agents
description: Clean Info Agents: /savvy-flow plans and hands work to five tiered agents, with a progress bar above the Infobar and a live panel of every agent.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow agent starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts
